title: 🔆🔅Dushanbe, October 19: First Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref arrived in Dushanbe, the capital of Tajikistan, to attend the meeting of Prime Ministers of the member states of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO).
text:
🔆🔅Dushanbe, October 19: First Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref arrived in Dushanbe, the capital of Tajikistan, to attend the meeting of Prime Ministers of the member states of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO)."

"Aref entered Dushanbe International Airport and was welcomed on arrival by Hakim Kholiqzoda, First Deputy Prime Minister of Tajikistan."

"During this two-day trip, the First Vice President will attend the SCO Prime Ministers’ meeting and will also hold meetings and talks with the Prime Ministers of some participating countries."

"Developing economic and trade cooperation, utilizing transport and logistics capacities, expanding cooperation in advanced technologies and artificial intelligence, and strengthening regional cooperation are among the most important priorities emphasized by the Islamic Republic of Iran at this meeting.
